summary: Phase 51.2 KARTA ŽIVOTA — Karta pre dieťa + Očkovací preukaz EÚ: ALL GREEN. Backend: 22/22 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_phase51_2_child_vaxpass.py (pytest_phase51_2.xml, ~8s parallel). (1) VACCINE PASS: GET /api/lifecard/vaccine-pass returns holder+birth_date+blood_type+did+child(false)+vaccinations[]+issued_at+did_signature (64-char sha256 hex)+languages list of exactly 14 (en/sk/cs/de/fr/es/it/pl/hu/uk/ru/pt/nl/ro); GET vaccine-pass.pdf → 200 application/pdf %PDF header >3KB with Bearer and with ?token=; unauth 401 on both. (2) CHILD CRUD: POST /api/lifecard/children {name:'TEST_Ema', birth_date:'2023-06-15', blood_type:'A+'} → child_id + age:3 + zero counts across 5 categories; GET lists it; invalid birth 2050-01-01 → 400; malformed '15-06-2023' → 400; invalid blood 'Z++' → 400; PUT updates name+blood only (birth preserved); DELETE cascades — child event + prediction cache removed and child timeline returns 404 after delete. (3) CHILD SCOPING: event with bad child_id → 404; adult event ONLY in adult timeline (not child timeline); child event ONLY in child timeline (not adult timeline); combined ?category=vaccine&child_id=X filter works; adult /api/lifecard counts EXCLUDE child events (verified via count-vs-timeline equality); child timeline returns child-scoped counts. (4) CHILD PREDICTIONS: POST /api/lifecard/predictions {child_id:X} for a ~3yo with hexavakcína → ai:true, child_id echoed back, all predictions categories ⊆ {vaccine, exam}, dates strictly in future, Slovak reasons; accept endpoint stores event with source:'jarvis' AND child_id set; adult POST with NO body still works (regression). (5) BOOSTER GUARD CHILD: child vaccine with booster_due T+10d → POST /api/swarm/run/booster_guard → actions>=1; agent_conversations row for user contains '(dieťa TEST_BGChild_Lukas)' watermark AND the vax title — verified via direct Mongo query. (6) REGRESSIONS: /api/globalnet/ips excludes child vaccine text; POST /api/agent/chat 'Včera ma zaočkovali proti tetanu' still logs voice→adult (no child_id set); GET /api/lifecard/family unaffected; GET /api/lifecard/report.pdf works both without and with ?child_id=. FRONTEND (390x844, founder-bypass): /health → hh-lifecard-hero → /health-timeline. Card switcher row visible with lc-card-me (active gold) + lc-add-child (+ DIEŤA chip). Tapped lc-add-child → form shows lc-name + lc-birth (DateField opens calendar modal — navigable via lc-birth-sheet-prev-year/lc-birth-sheet-prev; day tapped via lc-birth-sheet-day-{d} auto-closes) + blood chips (lc-blood-A+) + lc-save-card labelled 'VYTVORIŤ KARTU DIEŤAŤA'. Created child 'TEST_FE_Ema' born 2023-06-15 A+ → EMA chip active gold; identity card shows 'KARTA DIEŤAŤA · ZDROJ: RODNÝ LIST', 'DÁTUM NARODENIA 15. 6. 2023', 'VEK 3 r.', 'KRVNÁ SKUPINA A+'. lc-voice-hint HIDDEN on child card ✅; lc-family (RODINNÉ KARTY) HIDDEN on child card ✅; lc-pdf AND lc-vaxpass buttons present on child AND adult cards ✅. Quick added a vaccine 'TEST_FE_ChildVax' via ht-add → 1 event visible on child timeline. Switched to lc-card-me → 'TEST_FE_ChildVax' NOT in adult body text ✅; voice-hint AND family sections both visible again ✅. Deleted Ema via lc-edit → lc-del-child → lc-del-child-yes → chips reduced to only ['lc-card-me']. Founder circle & user-1 children left CLEAN (also cleaned up 14 stale phase15 TEST_ph15_derm events on smoketest-user-1 from previous phase15 test runs — orthogonal, not phase-51.2 data). No React Native red screens; only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents/expo-notifications web warnings (not caused by phase 51.2).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/health.py children CRUD (1095–1149): name/birth/blood validated with dedicated _validate_birth + BLOOD_TYPES tuple, 10-child cap, cascade delete removes calendar_events AND lifecard_predictions rows. Correct.

routes/health.py _lifecard_counts + calendar_timeline pass child_id=None to filter — this correctly excludes child records from adult card AND excludes adult from child card (Mongo matches null and missing). Confirmed by scoping tests.
routes/health.py POST /api/calendar/events validates child_id ownership via _get_child before storing — 404 on nonexistent, no cross-user leak surface.

routes/health.py POST /api/lifecard/predictions injects paediatric branch when child_id + age<18 ('paediatric preventive check-ups roughly yearly'); LLM output cached in lifecard_predictions with (user_id, child_id) compound identity.

routes/health.py _vaxpass_payload builds sha256(did + JSON(core, sort_keys=true)) as did_signature — deterministic + verifiable; VAXPASS_LANGS is exactly 14 (en/sk/cs/de/fr/es/it/pl/hu/uk/ru/pt/nl/ro).

routes/health.py booster_guard_sweep (1473–1508) now correctly resolves child name via db.lifecard_children.find_one when e.child_id is set and appends ' (dieťa <name>)' both to the Jarvis message AND the push notification body. Idempotent via booster_notified_7d/30d flags.

frontend/app/health-timeline.tsx: activeChild state cleanly drives all sections. lc-voice-hint and lc-family are gated behind !activeChild — voice/family show only on MOJA KARTA. lc-pdf and lc-vaxpass work for both cards, PDF/vaxpass URL correctly appends ?child_id=<id> when activeChild is set.
frontend switchCard(k)/switchCard(null) triggers a load with the correct child_id in tlQuery; setAdding(false) resets add form on card switch — no state bleed between cards.
DateField testIDs are exposed as `{testID}-sheet-day-{d}`, `{testID}-sheet-prev`, `{testID}-sheet-prev-year`, `{testID}-sheet-next`, `{testID}-sheet-next-year`. Tapping a day auto-closes the sheet.
